eyebrow: One command, first deploy or hundredth
code:
helm upgrade --install myapp-prod ./myapp \
  --values values.yaml \
  --values values-prod.yaml \
  --namespace prod \
  --atomic \
  --wait
caption: --install creates or upgrades; --wait blocks until ready; --atomic auto-rolls-back on failure.

code:
REVISION  UPDATED               STATUS      CHART        APP VERSION
1         Mon Oct 12 09:02:11  superseded  myapp-0.2.0  2.0.0
2         Tue Oct 13 14:40:55  superseded  myapp-0.3.0  2.1.0
3         Wed Oct 14 11:18:02  deployed    myapp-0.3.0  2.1.4
caption: Every install/upgrade/rollback is a new numbered, queryable revision.

eyebrow: Rolling back to a known-good revision
code:
helm rollback myapp-prod 2 --namespace prod

# re-applies revision 2's manifests + values
# as a NEW revision — history is never erased
caption: Omit the revision number to roll back to the immediately previous one.

steps.label: helm list --namespace prod
steps.sub: every release in that namespace, chart version, status

steps.label: helm get values myapp-prod --namespace prod
steps.sub: what's actually in effect right now, not just what values.yaml says

steps.label: helm uninstall myapp-prod --namespace prod
steps.sub: removes the release and, by default, its history
